svg.text: Time runs down. Each strand = 3 year lines.
each round is a stop, the final
White bar across the lines it
The next line bends out to make
Thin dashed line beside the strand;
The line splits evenly into two,
other lines step aside, then rejoin.
Name too long for the pill
Pill stays true to its dates;
the name goes in a flag beside it.
Two ringed stops joined by a black
